alt: The program traced line by line: a loop adds up a list of five numbers inside a function call, then factorial calls itself until n is 1, with one frame per call on the call stack, and each call hands its result back to the one below it.

Line 15 calls total_of with values = [3, 1, 4, 1, 5]. A new frame for total_of goes on top of the call stack.
total_of() starts running its body at line 2.

Line 4 runs: running changes from 8 to 9.
